items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to cognitive neuroscience, brain scanning techniques and Tulving's memory study.

items.title: All in the Mind — BBC Radio 4
items.description: Radio 4 series frequently features neuropsychology patients and brain imaging research — ideal extension for this lesson.

items.title: Meet Your Master — Getting to Know Your Brain: Crash Course Psychology #4
items.description: Introduces brain scanning methods (EEG, MRI) and the history of cognitive neuroscience in an accessible way.

items.title: Positron Emission Tomography Explained (PET Scan)
items.description: Step-by-step explanation of how a PET scan measures brain activity — one of the three scanning methods on the AQA spec.

items.title: GCSE Biology — CT and PET Scans Explained
items.description: GCSE-level explainer comparing CT and PET brain scans, covering how each technique produces different types of data.

items.title: Limitless
items.description: Thriller about a drug that unlocks the brain's full capacity — a thought-provoking film that raises questions about cognitive neuroscience and brain potential.

items.title: Simply Psychology — Biopsychology
items.description: Overview of brain scanning techniques including fMRI and PET — directly relevant to the neuroimaging content in this lesson.

items.title: AQA GCSE Psychology Teaching Resources
items.description: Official AQA teaching materials and mark schemes for the neuropsychology unit.
